shortName.description: The name the game's own grid shows; falls back to the full name when the item has none.

MapPoint.description: Coordinates are displayed rounded to x-precision digits; user-supplied coordinates are additionally bounded by the server to ±1e7.

autoPush.description: Show the recognition result in the overlay panel; the dashboard shows it either way.

templateMatching.description: Verify the name candidates against the items' own icons; off keeps the text-only pipeline.

templateStrict.description: Drop a row whose icon match stays below the template threshold instead of only re-ranking.

ocrUpscale.description: How much the capture is enlarged before OCR; small in-game labels read better scaled up.

ocrMinLength.description: Shortest cleaned-up text that can be an item name; counters like 50/50 stay below it.

candidateLimit.description: How many name candidates per text are offered to the icon check.

templateMinScale.description: Smallest icon size, as a fraction of the text label's width, the icon check tries.

templateMaxScale.description: Largest icon size, as a fraction of the text label's width, the icon check tries.

iconWindowRatio.description: Side of the square search area above a label, as a multiple of the label's width.

opacity.description: How opaque the recognition panel is over the game, as a percentage.

windowWidth.description: Width of the recognition panel, a tall strip rather than a wide bar.

windowHeight.description: Height of the recognition panel; the row list scrolls inside it.

rowsResolved.description: The client resolved every OCR text itself, so the backend must not match them by name again.

hotkeyFailed.description: Names of the OverlayHotkeys fields whose RegisterHotKey call was rejected, in OverlayHotkeys declaration order.
